_about: A synthetic weekly team sync (meeting mode tests, docs/MEETINGS.md). Written for the test, said by macOS voices. 'side' is which track the line is on: 'you' (the microphone) or 'call'. 'expect' lists what the notes must contain: each entry is a set of words that must all appear in one item.
lines: Morning everyone. Let's get going, we've got three things today: the spring catalog, the warehouse move, and hiring.
Morning. Um, I can start with the catalog if that's okay.
So the printer came back with a quote of eighteen thousand dollars for twenty thousand copies. That's about two thousand over what we budgeted.
Is that with the heavier paper?
Yes, the heavier paper. If we go back to the standard stock it comes down to about sixteen thousand.
Let's stay with the standard stock. The heavier paper isn't worth two thousand dollars to me.
Okay. I'll tell the printer today and get a revised proof by Thursday.
Right. The new lease starts on March first. The movers can do the last weekend of February, but they need a deposit by next Friday.
Fine. Send me the invoice and I'll approve it this week.
Will do. The other question is whether we keep the old storage unit for overflow. I honestly don't know yet how much space we'll have.
Let's decide that after you've walked the new space. No rush on it.
Last thing, hiring. We still need someone for customer support. Dana, any good candidates?
Two strong ones. I'd like to bring both in for interviews next week.
Do it. Set them up for Tuesday or Wednesday, and I'll sit in on both.
Perfect, I'll send you the times tomorrow.
Okay, that's everything. Thanks both of you.
